title: Стандарт державної мови «Український правопис». Офіційне видання
publisher: Національна комісія зі стандартів державної мови
usedFor: The current official spelling norm. Used for the 33-letter alphabet (4.1), the letters Г and Ґ (§5, §6), the apostrophe rules and the apostrophe character used in the official text (§7), the у/в, і/й and з/із/зі alternations (§23–§25), and capital Ви/Ваш in letters and official documents (§60.2).
notes: Approved by Commission decision No. 47 of 1 March 2026; in force from 28 March 2026. It is the 2019 orthography with editorial and technical corrections only (see kmu-pravopys-standard-2026). Read as text extracted from the PDF. The PDF writes stressed а, е, о with precomposed Latin letters (á, é, ó) and other stressed vowels with U+0301, so Ukrainian examples must never be copied from it verbatim.
